title: Gold Under Guard
pages:
A bastion. Gold stacked in rooms with no doors.

The piglins watch me as if I owe them something. I think the place keeps a ledger and I am in it.

He wanted this treasure once. Not for the gold. For the proof that he had been brave enough to go and take it.

There is a kind of hoard that is only a trophy case for a man's fear.
Nothing here is guarded against thieves. It is guarded against being forgotten.
